evidence_type: Static analysis of original Spitfire 1.6.0 build 2005-03-18 and recovered resources; not a new runtime observation or hardware validation.

critical_hazards.trigger: Successful initial connection / subsystem Empower reinitialization
critical_hazards.conclusion: Application startup automatically queues a state-setting command, regardless of Opt-out. Do not classify startup as pure query traffic or execute this command in the simulator.

critical_hazards.trigger: Response to1067 TDG:OSC:MODE? lacks literal INT
critical_hazards.conclusion: Read-response processing can automatically queue mode changes. Responses are test fixtures; do not invent/change existing fixture state to suppress this silently.
Deferred channel reset command on next polling round.
Never use generic Escape to dismiss menus/dialogs. Close only an identified safe close control.
Do not press; timer acts after strictly more than3 whole seconds.
Opening faults is allowed, clearing/resetting is prohibited.

optout.read_semantics: Decoder stores integer in emp_optout and panel2/control9. Exactly1 hides main Empower communication control. Nonzero opt-out suppresses normal Empower status decoding, but does not eliminate startup or periodic Empower queries.
optout.eligibility: Read current simulator/controller fixture configuration and, if already running, guest current readback. If off, report and stop requested Opt-out-on test. Do not set to1 or substitute fixture silently.
optout.persistence: No demonstrated local persistence: user_settings filename alone is not proof. No WritePrivateProfileString xrefs recovered.
optout.simulator_default_warning: Local canonical SimulatedTransport initializes EMPOPTOUT? to0; p07 copy/fixture must be checked separately.

allowlist_policy: Inspect controls and menus in XP guest process before activating anything; identify text, callback/resource correlation and current geometry.
No generic coordinate sweep, Tab/Enter sweep, double-click, mouse-wheel or Escape. Do not activate disabled entries via messages.
Readbacks and screenshots require no activation. Do not click numeric fields, switches, sliders or blank-labelled controls.
Menus: Empower Setup, Active Faults, Timing and High Voltage, Temperature Control, About; use close controls explicitly listed as allowed.

regensvc typed to identified main-panel background is a local display/access change permitted by task; it adds four measured-HV polling IDs. Do not type in editable controls or console. Return via identified lower-level control or literal user sequence.
Quit only identified File Exit or QuitProgram; callbacks quit UI without hardware OFF. Restart repeats automatic startup commands.

Startup/restart only after Opt-out and isolation gates and immutable simulator command rejection. Save all actual outbound bytes including automatically generated commands. Rejection responses must be labelled simulated and not interpreted as successful hardware writes.
Do not read simulator response tables as real-controller behavior.

skip_categories: all numeric settings, delays, divisor, PRF, pulsewidth, source, mode

polling.initial_identity: 1000 *idn? attempted three times, each with response/3-second wait
polling.caution: 1000-series alone is not sufficient allowlisting:1026 is TDG:DEL without question mark. Validate exact recovered query title, not merely numeric range.
